interface.description: Network interface to listen on for SIP packets.

port_range.description: SIP port range to capture, e.g., '5060-5061' or '5060'.

bpf_filter_file.description: Path to a file containing a BPF filter. Overrides command-line BPF filter.

hep_capture_url.description: HEP Capture Server URL in ip:port format for duplicate matching traffic.

packet_limit.description: Maximum number of packets to match before exiting. 0 means no limit.

timeout_seconds.description: Terminate sipgrep after this many seconds. 0 means no time limit.

show_subprotocol.description: Show sub-protocol number along with single-character identifier.

no_drop_privileges.description: Do not try to drop privileges to DROPPRIVS_USER. Use with caution.

no_promiscuous.description: Don't put the interface into promiscuous mode.

disable_dialog_cleanup.description: Disable clean-up of Dialogs during trace.

print_timestamps.description: Print a timestamp in the form of +S.UUUUUU.

match_word.description: Match the regex expression as a word.

use_colors.description: Use colors in stdout. Set to false to disable.

snaplen.description: Set the bpf caplen to snaplen. Default 65536.

limitlen.description: Set the upper limit on the size of packets that sipgrep will look at. Default 65536.

output_pcap.description: Output matched packets to a pcap-compatible dump file. Empty means stdout.

match_contact_user.description: Match user in Contact: SIP header.

match_from_user.description: Match user in From: SIP header.

match_to_user.description: Match user in To: SIP header.

match_user_agent.description: For matching user-agent strings send SIP packet-of-death to SipVicious scanners.

match_expression.description: Match expression (extended regular expression). Used if bpf_filter_file is not set.
